newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for slaying father.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for slaying father.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Saudi man convicted of shooting dead his father and hiding the body in an abandoned well, Saudi state television reported.
It quoted an interior ministry statement as saying the man was arrested after police uncovered his father's body in an abandoned well.
An Islamic court sentenced the man to death after finding him guilty of shooting his father over a dispute and hiding the body, the statement added. It did not specify the nature of the dispute.
The man was executed after the sentence was approved by a higher judicial body.
The beheading in the kingdom's Eastern Province brought to 45 the number of people executed in Saudi Arabia this year.
The conservative kingdom strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drugs smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
